**F.J. García-Martínez, F. Osorio and F. González-Gómez** (*Water*, 2025; JCR Q2). [Read the article](https://doi.org/10.3390/w17121750).

**The question.** Do people in small villages get the same water services as people in cities?

**What they found.**

- Water management in Spain shows two very different realities: populated areas and small towns.
- Small municipalities face specific problems in managing the urban water cycle.
- Recommendations: create optimal service areas and an independent regulatory body.

**Key result (in the video).** Two realities of water management, and what to do. *Source: Water (2025), province of Granada (Spain).*

**Why it matters.** Better organisation and regulation can bring rural water services closer to urban standards.

**Link with inequality.** Territorial inequality: whether you live in a city or a village should not decide the quality of your water service.
